project_overview.concept: WhatsApp-style Chat Application with Chat Folders integrated with a Modern Property Listings Marketplace
project_overview.aesthetic_archetype: Organic Pro Precision - WhatsApp Dark & Light Modern Hybrid (Emerald Charcoal Accent Palette)

layout_and_spacing.chat_app_layout: Fixed viewport full-height split screen (100vh). Left panel chat sidebar (320px - 400px), center main view chat window / listings, right info panel / details drawer.
layout_and_spacing.folders_navigation: Top horizontal capsule list or icon rail for Chat Folders: All, Unread, Groups, Favorites, Listings Chat, Archived.
layout_and_spacing.listings_grid: Mode B High Density / Bento Grid layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6).
layout_and_spacing.padding_rules: All bordered card containers MUST have minimum p-4 to p-6 padding to prevent text collision.

component_guidelines.chat_list_item: Includes avatar, online status dot, unread badge (pill with primary color), folder tag, bold title, truncated preview, timestamp, double checkmark read receipts.
component_guidelines.message_bubble: Rounded corners with tail snippet, sent bubble in #005C4B with white text, received bubble in #202C33, reaction stickers, double tick indicator, timestamp.
component_guidelines.listing_card: Rounded-2xl surface (#202C33) with crisp 1px border (#222D34), smooth hover float effect (-translate-y-1), price badge, photo carousel, location map chip, quick 'Message Host' button.
component_guidelines.mapbox_integration: Dark themed Mapbox view container with glowing custom markers and popup card previews for property listings.
component_guidelines.auth_pages: Centered glassmorphism card (bg-[#111B21]/90 backdrop-blur-xl), clear input fields with focus ring #00A884, passport local login / signup toggle.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons and cards must have explicit hover states (e.g. hover:bg-[#008F70] hover:text-white transition-all duration-200).
motion_and_interactions.animations: Framer motion for tab switches between chat folders, list item staggered fade-in, message send pop-in animation.

testing_and_attributes.data_testid_policy: ALL interactive buttons, inputs, navigation links, folder tabs, message bubbles, and listing cards MUST have data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

listings.description: Minimalist modern apartment living room with green sofa
Modern white kitchen with wooden accent wall

instructions_for_main_agent: Build the React application using .js / .jsx file extensions.
Use WhatsApp-inspired dark palette (#0B141A background, #111B21 panel, #00A884 emerald primary, #005C4B sent message bubble).
Implement real-time chat with Chat Folders rail (All, Unread, Groups, Favorites, Marketplace).
Ensure every interactive element has a data-testid attribute.
Include full Passport auth flow integration, Mapbox geocoding listing map, listing CRUD, reviews, and cascading delete logic.
